summary: Fallback multi-protocol fragmentation drops terminal sentence and trailing emoji when WS->longpoll fails over
description: Issue summary: Several customers (first reported by Sentinel Health) observe that when a streaming session falls back from WebSocket to long-poll (or HTTP chunked longpoll) during a short network disruption, the final sentence(s) of the model response and trailing inline emoji/images are missing in the client UI. Impact: production customers see truncated responses, usually losing punctuation, the last clause, and trailing emoji or markdown image URLs. This affects user-visible correctness and downstream processing. Environment: production, us-east endpoints, connections typically go through a corporate edge proxy that performs WS downgrade for flaky mobile/corp networks. Repro frequency: intermittent but reproducible in lab under proxy-induced ws->longpoll handoff. Correlation ids from customer traces: trace=tr-7b2a1c0, session=ssn-91a2b, example request_id=req-4f8c31.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use the JS client-sdk v1.2.5 configured to allow fallback (default) behind the enterprise edge proxy that strips WebSocket upgrades on flakey connections
2) Start a streaming generation (chat) with a long output that ends with a short clause followed by emoji and a markdown image URL
3) Induce a transient drop at the proxy layer to force the SDK into the long-poll fallback path (tooling attached below),

4) Observe client UI: response completes but the final sentence finalizer punctuation and trailing emoji/image URL are missing; server logs still show end-of-stream marker delivered before connection close
5) Reproduce with curl longpoll: hit /v1/stream with chunked response, then interrupt and re-establish via GET - the reassembled body sometimes omits the final chunk under the same proxy conditions
logs: 2026-02-27T16:12:43Z req=req-4f8c31 stream_event=delta data="...and that should do it"
2026-02-27T16:12:44Z req=req-4f8c31 client_receive=chunked [partial body without trailing emoji]
investigation: Initial hypothesis: terminal 'end' marker delivered but client reassembly on long-poll path drops the last small chunk when an adjacent heartbeat-only chunk arrives during conversion

Captured pcap and server-side chunk boundaries: the server emits terminal chunk with sequence=56 (small payload 12 bytes) immediately followed by a keepalive chunk; in proxy conversion the small terminal chunk is coalesced into the previous chunk and then truncated by the proxy's chunk rewriter

JS SDK v1.2.5 reassembly logic: accepts chunked frames and treats heartbeat-only frames ("hb") as no-op; however when downgrade occurs the SDK's fallback handler switches to polling code which merges frames using a regex that expects terminal JSON delimiting. The regex fails for very small terminal tokens and drops trailing punctuation/emojis during string concatenation

Server side: serving-runtime logs show the full payload was produced and end-of-stream marker posted before connection teardown (see logs). No evidence of model generating incomplete text. No errors in kernel selection or serving runtime.

Edge proxy: corp proxy (vendor X) configured with aggressive chunk coalescing/trim for HTTP/1.1; vendor-simulations reproduce the drop behavior when 'trim-empty-chunks' and 'coalesce-adjacent' flags are enabled
comments: Aisha Patel (Support): Customer reported on 2026-02-27; provided example requests and screenshots. Initial triage indicates streaming termination visible on server but missing in client.
Miguel Torres (SRE): Captured server trace and coordination ids; forwarding pcap and edge-proxy config to infra for reproduction. Assigned to me for deeper analysis.

Iris Zhang (Client SDK): Reproduced locally with proxy-sim and confirmed SDK concatenation regex fails to preserve trailing UTF-8 emoji bytes when chunk boundary occurs mid-codepoint. Drafting patch to the polling path to use a deterministic buffer + sequence checks instead of regex.

Customer (Sentinel Health - Ops): We see this on some users behind corporate mobile proxies. Workaround applied: set SDK option streamingMode=wsOnly — reduces incidence but not acceptable long-term for corp clients.
Miguel Torres (SRE): Filed infra ticket INT-4123 to capture proxy behavior across regions and enable a synthetic test on our chaos cluster to validate downgrade scenarios.
Iris Zhang (Client SDK): PR open with changes and unit tests: github.com/redwood/client-sdk/pull/4150
resolution: Workaround: advised customer to set client option streamingMode="wsOnly" to avoid fallback until SDK patch is released. Permanent fix: client-sdk v1.2.8 (patch) updates polling reassembly to use a length-prefixed buffer and sequence number sanity checks; edge-proxy guidance added to recommend disabling coalesce/trim flags for longpoll conversions. Patch PR merged and released to npm as v1.2.8. Follow-ups: add e2e tests simulating proxy downgrade, add metric streaming.incomplete_terminal_count and alerting, and coordinate with infra to flag regions with aggressive proxy rewriting.
